name: Outpost Supply
description: Deliver 10 Birch Logs and 5 Copper Ore to Ralph the Blacksmith.

narrative.accept: Ralph the Blacksmith wipes soot from his brow. "The guards at the outpost need supplies. Bring me 10 Birch Logs and 5 Copper Ore, and I'll prepare a shipment."
narrative.complete: "Superb craftsmanship requires good raw materials. These logs and copper ore are perfect. Vaelen will be pleased with the new shields!"
narrative.hint: Gather Birch Logs from Birch Thicket and Copper Ore from Forgotten Ironmine.
